issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases, focusing only on the happy path.
The skill file contains verbose explanatory text that could be trimmed for brevity.

scenarios.name: create-react-tabs-app

scenarios.rationale: Response A covers installation, sync, import, and rendering photo.webPath (though it uses IonButton instead of IonFabButton), while Response B fails to use photo.webPath and IonFabButton, making it less complete.
